name: qw_lgr_ref-w1-COMMIT
purpose: WQ3 quant cluster read lane-group leaf (8 lanes, hardened once, x4 on the cluster W face): die-face pin flops (wrr 2,056 in, wrq 128 out), two read quads (flat), read relays stage 2, pair gather register gp 1,024 on the E face toward the data head.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_qw_lgr u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/qw/ot_hgi_qw_rq.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/qw/ot_hgi_qw_lg2.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qw_lgr_ref/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qw_lgr_ref/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qw_lgr_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_qw_lgr  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: quant_wide_ov flat cluster (38,353 flops + 20 macro clock pins on one root: ov1 crash, ov2 cancelled at 32-38k sinks with 495-727 ps CTS spread, ov3 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD) is replaced by a wires-only parent over hardened M5 leaves with their own clock roots: control head ot_hgi_qw_ovc, data head ot_hgi_qw_ovd (result SRAM + write side), 4 x read lane-group leaf ot_hgi_qw_lgr, 4 x write lane-group leaf ot_hgi_qw_lgw, the three closed decoder tiles; a register at both pins of every seam, no cycle added (gate quant_wide_ov: 184 cycles vs 168 priced = 1.095x, unchanged)
